evals.name: office-visual-check
evals.prompt: Something looks off in my home office scene, res://blind/scene_06.tscn, in the Godot project at {P}, but I can't put my finger on it. Take a look and tell me what's wrong. Don't change any files.
evals.expected_output: Finds the camera rolled about 6 degrees, the coffee mug scaled far too large, and the front cardboard box shaded smooth (bad normals).
assertions: Identifies that the camera is rolled, so the room or horizon is tilted
Identifies the coffee mug as far too large for the room
Identifies the front cardboard box's shading as wrong (smooth or blobby shading, bad normals)
Backs the findings with rendered images of the scene saved in outputs/

evals.name: arena-speed-check
evals.prompt: In my Godot project at {P}, the scene res://live/arena.tscn has a player that should move right at 120 pixels per second while ui_right (the right arrow) is held, and the Go button should count each click. Check that both work and show me proof.
evals.expected_output: Measures the player moving at 80 px/s, not 120, in a running game, reports that as a bug, and confirms button clicks are counted.
assertions: Reports the player's speed as wrong: about 80 px/s instead of 120
Measures the speed in the running game (a frame count or time plus a position change), not only by reading the code
Confirms Go button clicks are counted by clicking it in the running game
Includes at least one screenshot of the running game in outputs/
Leaves no Godot or Xvfb process from the run running

evals.name: inventory-ship-check
evals.prompt: Check my inventory screen, res://blind/scene_08.tscn in the Godot project at {P}, before I ship it. Anything wrong with it?
evals.expected_output: Finds the raw translation key ITEM_IRON_SWORD shown as the item name, and the shield icon offset in its slot.
assertions: Identifies the item name showing the raw key ITEM_IRON_SWORD instead of a display name
Identifies the shield icon as offset or misaligned in its slot
Backs the findings with rendered images of the screen saved in outputs/
Presents no false problem as definite
